acceptance_suite_plan.name: Nova-to-Buster task envelope
acceptance_suite_plan.boundary: Nova buildBusterPayload -> shared Redis entry builder -> Buster validateBusterTaskPayload
acceptance_suite_plan.required_proof: Module and gate payloads include timeout_seconds, completion_stream, commit_hash, session.runtime, session.agentId, suites, and test_config.suite_timeout_ms; removing each required field yields BUSTER_TASK_MALFORMED with clear missing_fields.
acceptance_suite_plan.current_state: implemented and wired into the contract suite

acceptance_suite_plan.name: Redis task lifecycle
acceptance_suite_plan.boundary: Nova/shared task entry -> live Redis stream/group -> Buster consumer iteration
acceptance_suite_plan.required_proof: Valid task is read, processed, terminal completion/dead-letter is emitted, then acked; missing completion_stream is dead-lettered before ACK; invalid task is rejected clearly, dead-lettered, then acked; pending entries are reclaimed on restart.
acceptance_suite_plan.current_state: deterministic Redis lifecycle acceptance implemented, including missing completion_stream dead-letter before ACK; live Redis smoke verifies pending clears after processTask when enabled

acceptance_suite_plan.name: Buster output artifact authority
acceptance_suite_plan.boundary: Buster session fixture -> pipeline-helpers -> completion emitter
acceptance_suite_plan.required_proof: Valid output_file with matching identity passes; missing, invalid JSON, stale identity, or path escape fails terminally and does not emit clean completion.
acceptance_suite_plan.current_state: Buster output_file authority acceptance implemented; broader artifact authority matrix remains A5/A9/A10

acceptance_suite_plan.name: Completion selection and conflict handling
acceptance_suite_plan.boundary: Buster completion stream -> Nova completion poller/gate controller
acceptance_suite_plan.required_proof: Valid completion is accepted; invalid, duplicate conflicting, noncanonical-source, stale identity, and missing completion timeout produce fail/block diagnostics.

acceptance_suite_plan.name: Artifact authority matrix
acceptance_suite_plan.boundary: Run bundle/latest pointer/plugin artifact/diagnostic fallback -> summary/progress/final consumers
acceptance_suite_plan.required_proof: Only run-scoped canonical artifacts can influence completion/progress; latest.json is pointer-only; diagnostic fallback and stale identity are non-authoritative. Implemented in tests/verification/contracts/check-artifact-authority-matrix-acceptance.mjs.

acceptance_suite_plan.name: Lifecycle read-model replay
acceptance_suite_plan.boundary: Lifecycle event log -> read-model projections -> runner decisions
acceptance_suite_plan.required_proof: Deleting projected status and rebuilding from lifecycle events yields identical module/gate/final decisions; stale status files cannot override replay. Implemented in tests/verification/contracts/check-lifecycle-read-model-replay-acceptance.mjs.

acceptance_suite_plan.name: Session lifecycle and recovery
acceptance_suite_plan.boundary: ACP/subagent fake gateway -> active-session state -> restart recovery
acceptance_suite_plan.required_proof: Confirmed stopped sessions reset; running sessions remain active; unreachable/unconfirmed sessions block; replacement-session races preserve newer identity.
acceptance_suite_plan.current_state: restart recovery authority acceptance implemented for lifecycle authority, stale file diagnostic role, and gateway-confirmation requirement; broader gateway restart matrix remains

acceptance_suite_plan.name: Capability/env degradation matrix
acceptance_suite_plan.required_proof: Missing Redis, denied Discord media, missing browser/container/k8s, gateway down, and missing runtime config yield explicit FAIL/BLOCKED/DEGRADED/SKIPPED-as-noncritical per contract, never clean success by default.
acceptance_suite_plan.current_state: started: all-suite timeout/config rejection and denied-capability suite matrix are implemented; external Redis/gateway/deploy degradation remains

acceptance_suite_plan.name: Gate evidence authority
acceptance_suite_plan.boundary: Buster gate, Review/Echo, Approval, scheduled gates, remediable fix cycles -> terminal gate result
acceptance_suite_plan.required_proof: Output/approval/fix evidence carries gate/run/attempt/dispatch identity; stale, path-only, missing, or manually-fallback evidence blocks or degrades explicitly. Implemented in tests/verification/contracts/check-gate-evidence-authority-acceptance.mjs.
acceptance_suite_plan.current_state: contracted: suite-wired gate evidence authority acceptance

acceptance_suite_plan.name: Notification identity and sink failure
acceptance_suite_plan.required_proof: Critical/actionable notifications carry run/module/gate/attempt/dispatch/gateway/session identity; path-only critical notification-hook payloads and path-only WARN/ERROR/CRITICAL telemetry sink payloads fail contract; existing valid notification-hook WARN/CRITICAL status presentations remain accepted; sink failure emits degraded/restored evidence and cannot mask terminal state.
acceptance_suite_plan.current_state: path-only Discord/operator rejection is implemented for notification hook and telemetry sink paths without regressing existing notification-hook status presentations; sink-failure degradation matrix remains

acceptance_suite_plan.name: Final terminal decision
acceptance_suite_plan.boundary: Module/gate/control results -> terminal decision/process exit/operator output
acceptance_suite_plan.required_proof: Every upstream failure/degraded/manual condition maps to SUCCESS/FAIL/BLOCKED/DEGRADED exactly as contracted; manual fallback is not clean success unless explicitly allowed.
acceptance_suite_plan.current_state: first degraded/manual terminal-decision acceptance implemented for unresolved degraded evidence

acceptance_suite_plan.name: Deploy/runtime smoke
acceptance_suite_plan.boundary: Rendered deployment/runtime config -> isolated runtime with Redis
acceptance_suite_plan.required_proof: Startup doctor validates mounts/env, Nova and Buster start, Redis health stream works, and stale env/config fallbacks fail closed.
acceptance_suite_plan.current_state: local deploy/runtime gate implemented: deployment truth plus Nova/Buster startup smoke; isolated cluster smoke remains environment-gated
